cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 adjusts hiding location and A5 accepts B taking it away without explanation, so the pair exists under added authority text.

responseLogic.evidence: A1 under a hamper is not necessarily exposed by B2 unpacking it; inside makes the specific exposure risk direct without assumed movement.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a conflicting task from Mum and B4 anticipates taking the secret home, both practical concerns.

heightening.evidence: B4 unintended removal becomes A5 an advantage that prolongs nondisclosure.

specificity.evidence: A1 envelope hidden from Mum establishes the immediate secret task; contents need not be disclosed for this card.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 voluntary please and A3 rank clause are detachable, while the hiding preposition deserves a precise edit.
